title: The Mage
timelinePosition: Opens on the exact beat where Chapter 1 ends: after dusk, in the Pass cell, Sylvanas standing over Jaina's chair. Jaina has been awake since before her pre-dawn crossing and in custody since first light. The party leaves the Pass at night (B6 mounts immediately). Because B13 arrives in fading light, the ride covers the night and the following day; the writer must mark the passage between B8 and B10.
openLocation: Farstrider border post at Thalassian Pass, inside the containment ward circle
transport: On foot inside the ward circle at open; southbound on Thalassian horses once Sylvanas lets her out.
immediateObjective: Get Sylvanas to act on the contamination before more time is lost.
constraints: Absolute limited third on Jaina; no head-hopping, nothing she could not perceive or infer
Do not replay Chapter 1's closing line 'Start talking'; Beat 1 opens from Sylvanas's order already given
Jaina does not know Sylvanas felt a stone read wrong or saw it circled on the map
No confirmation that grain is the carrier; do not name grain, bread or flour as cause
No trust and no warmth between Jaina and Sylvanas; grim working alignment only
Jaina's first read of Sylvanas as cold military obstruction breaks at Beat 9 and not earlier
Cyndia in pre-Ch10 voice: crisp, professional, volunteers field observations
The unnamed fourth ranger is background only; no continuity built around her
Lyriel does not use Jaina's first name in this chapter; she is the only ranger who talks to Jaina and jokes
Neral is a relay rider and strong rider; she appears only in Ch 2-3

Address: Sylvanas calls Jaina 'Mage' (or 'Proudmoore' in front of others), never 'Jaina'. Jaina calls her 'Ranger-General', a little too correct. Lyriel uses 'Lady Proudmoore', mock-solemn. Neral barely addresses Jaina, and only by title. Cyndia says 'Ranger-General'.
Jaina voice: no counted time in narration or speech. Render the outline's 'eight hours' as an event marker.
Ch1 cell geometry is fixed: one chair (Jaina seated), the wall ward-stone behind her head, a room barely wider than its door, Cyndia at the threshold.
The sending stone is the Ch1 rune pebble (flat, grey, one rune, wrapped in cloth). Do not re-describe it as a different object.
Jaina may not know her crossing went unfelt. Do not explain how she crossed the rings; that thread stays open.

povKnowsAtOpen: The leylines south of the border are contaminated by something necromantic
She can identify the signature as broadly death-aligned even though the banned discipline sits outside her formal training
She crossed into Quel'Thalas tracking the corruption
The Kirin Tor did not authorize the trip and Antonidas does not know exactly where she is
povDoesNotKnowAtOpen: Whether Sylvanas already knows who she is
Whether the elves will release her or keep her prisoner
What the contamination is doing to the physical ground beyond the leylines
The exact process that turns living contamination into post-death behavior
mustNotBeImpliedYet: Immediate trust between Jaina and Sylvanas
Proof of an organized cult network
Anything warmer than a grim, working alignment
castKnowsLeavingChapter: Sylvanas is convinced enough to release Jaina and ride south with her
The contamination is physical, lethal and large enough to threaten the whole region, active in living flesh before death
The riding party is Sylvanas, Jaina, Cyndia, Lyriel, Neral and one unnamed escort ranger, heading to Millhaven
The entry method for the sickness is still unknown
Lyriel is the ranger who talks to Jaina on the road

pov: She opens convinced that if she can explain the magic clearly enough, any sensible person will act.
She starts out treating Sylvanas as another soldier standing in her way.
Because she assumes soldiers need the short version, she talks smaller than she really thinks.
By the end, Jaina still hates being under guard, but she stops treating Sylvanas like a blunt instrument and starts seeing how much she needs her on the road.

beats: Jaina first reads Sylvanas as a cold military obstruction: dangerous, precise, and mostly interested in custody.
That read breaks when Sylvanas listens fast, reads the map sharply, and handles the road like someone who actually knows what matters.
Once Sylvanas proves she can follow the problem, Jaina drops the watered-down explanation.

team.label: Partnership
beats: They start as prisoner and custodian. If Jaina gets out, it will be on a leash.
As the chapter moves, the custody arrangement turns into a working investigation.
There is still no trust and no warmth. They are only starting to become useful to each other.

castAndHandoffRules: Sylvanas Windrunner: leads the ride south once she decides to test Jaina's claim.
Ranger Cyndia: border-post officer who becomes the active escort lead.
Ranger Lyriel: right-flank escort and best shot in the mounted detail; the one ranger who talks to Jaina on the road and jokes where Cyndia will not.
Ranger Neral: third named escort and strongest rider; relay rider if word must go back.
Unnamed fourth ranger: background escort only. Do not build continuity around her.
Next chapter starts: Chapter 3 opens with this same party approaching Millhaven; all three named escorts and the unnamed ranger present.

chapterBridge.previousChapterClose: Ch1 ends in Sylvanas's POV after dusk in the Pass cell. She has stepped in and stopped in front of the chair, close enough that the seated mage must tip her head back. She holds a silence (a cup set down in the guardroom), then: 'Start talking.'
chapterBridge.continuityOfState: Same room, same moment, POV handed to Jaina. Do not replay the line; B1 opens with the order already given. Jaina's clock differs from Sylvanas's: awake since before dawn, held since first light, her claim already written down and drawered by the watch.
chapterBridge.informationAsymmetry: Sylvanas holds the noon stone (late beat, cold under warmth) and the circle on the map. Jaina holds the scale of the contamination and the silent sending stone. Neither knows what the other holds.
chapterBridge.orientingAnchor: Jaina's head tipped back to Sylvanas's face; the wall stone humming behind her own head; the ward-lamp light. One brief callback is enough, not a re-description of the cell.
chapterBridge.intentionalJump: POV switch only; no time skip.

scene.title: The Wildlife Attack
scene.sceneFunction: The plague turns physical and violent, and Jaina sees how Sylvanas handles a real fight.
scene.knowledgeAtSceneStart: The land is contaminated, but the living cost hasn't shown its teeth yet. Daylight on the second day; Millhaven is reached in fading light. The custody terms still stand.

beats.goal: Survive the ambush while Jaina casts on instinct.
beats.conflict: Sick wild-eyed deer burst from the trees, wolves hit the horses from the flank; the fight is too fast for planning; one deer keeps moving when it should be dead.

outcome.summary: Sylvanas commands with almost no wasted words and the escort does its part cleanly; the field is clear but Jaina must face what the theory means in flesh.

newOnPageInformation: Sylvanas processes the whole field and commands economically
Cyndia, Lyriel and Neral each do clean work
One deer keeps moving after it should be dead
stillUnknownAfterBeat: Whether this is one cursed patch of woods or the new rule for the region
sensoryAnchors: wolves crashing in from the side
beats.transitionIntent: planted question: the deer that would not go down demands examination
beats.plannerWarning: 'Keeps moving after it should be dead' is ambiguous against B12's active-before-death finding. Write it as wounded and still on its feet, not a reanimated corpse. No organized undead column.
beats.continuityNote: First fight with the party. Sylvanas's established combat profile (Ch1: waits the shot, reads quarry behaviour, clipped field calls) is seen from outside for the first time, through someone who isn't a fighter.
beats.povNote: Jaina can't see Sylvanas 'process the whole field'. She sees the fight take shape around Sylvanas's calls (partnership-arc.md: 'the first time she sees the shape Sylvanas gives a fight'). Her view is narrow and incomplete. Lyriel's combat calls are direction, target, action with no jokes; Sylvanas is loud on a field (voice sheet).

beats.goal: Examine the carcasses to learn whether this is isolated or part of the spreading pattern.
beats.conflict: She must put her hand in the corrupted flesh while horses shy and the party waits on her read.

outcome.summary: The necromantic agent is in tissue, blood and organs and active in living flesh before death; Sylvanas holds the company for the read, then they remount and push hard toward the strongest wrongness.

newOnPageInformation: The agent is embedded in tissue, blood and organs
It is active in living flesh before death
Sylvanas holds the company and waits on Jaina's read
stillUnknownAfterBeat: How the sickness first entered the animals
beats.transitionIntent: action continuation: the remount and the hard push toward where the wrongness is strongest
interiority: active before death, the interesting part, and she hates that it is
hand in a dead deer and already drafting the next test
who ate from these fields, how long ago
puts the sick feeling off until after the read, as if it will wait
beats.plannerWarning: Interiority mentions 'who ate from these fields'. Allow it as a question, never an answer; do not confirm grain or any food as carrier.
beats.continuityNote: Ladder position (plague-mechanism.md, Ch 2-3): Jaina sees necromancy, design, saturation, ingress and reanimation, but can't yet split carrier, host change and death trigger. 'Active in living flesh before death' is the furthest this chapter goes.
beats.pacingNote: This is the breathing room after the B11 peak. It works as a sequel in function (reaction, then dilemma, then the decision to push on) even though it is typed as a scene.
beats.arcLanding: Partnership bullet 2 ('custody turns into a working investigation') lands here: Sylvanas holds the company on Jaina's read.

beats.emotion: Dread settles flat as the village already looks as dead as the animals.
beats.dilemma: Ride into silence not knowing if anyone living remains, or hold back.
beats.decision: They close the last stretch and ride up on Millhaven.
newOnPageInformation: The magical wrongness knots tightest here
stillUnknownAfterBeat: Whether a single living person is left inside
beats.transitionIntent: planted question: is a single living person left inside? Chapter 3 (Sylvanas POV) opens riding up on the settlement
beats.continuityNote: First sight of Millhaven (location notes: crossroads, mill, tavern, a few dozen lives, doors open and people gone). Keep the interior for Ch3: arrival only.
beats.intraChapterEcho: The wrongness knotting tightest here confirms Sylvanas's B9 pinch-point read without anyone saying so.
beats.arcLanding: POV bullet 4 includes 'still hates being under guard'. The custody terms from B5 (armed escort, watched hands, no wandering) haven't lapsed, and that must still register in S2 or S3 by the close. Also partnership bullet 3: no warmth.
